marketLayer.title: HK Tech Giants Capex & AI Commercialization
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed tech leaders including Tencent and Alibaba reported sustained Q2 AI capex increases alongside resilient growth in cloud computing and targeted advertising revenues.
marketLayer.inference: Near-term operating margins may face minor compression, but accelerated enterprise AI deployment will enhance long-term monetization efficiency and structural earnings growth.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Domestic consumer spending recovery momentum and potential adjustments to cross-border tech export regulations.

marketLayer.title: US Monetary Policy & Equity Capital Flows
marketLayer.fact: U.S. macroeconomic indicators showed cooling inflation metrics, maintaining market expectations for a 25 bps rate cut at the upcoming FOMC meeting while the 10-year Treasury yield stabilized.
marketLayer.inference: Reduced yield volatility offers macro liquidity support to mega-cap US technology equities, encouraging risk-on capital rotation across growth sectors.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sticky non-housing service inflation and incoming non-farm payroll employment data releases.

marketLayer.title: China New Energy Vehicles Export Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Leading Hong Kong-listed EV manufacturers recorded strong double-digit year-over-year overseas delivery growth, expanding operational presence across Southeast Asian and Latin American markets.
marketLayer.inference: Superior supply chain cost structure and rapid iteration cycles continue to offset localized trade tariff headwinds, supporting overall segment gross margin resiliency.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Domestic market price war escalation and regulatory policy shifts regarding regional market entry barriers.

marketLayer.title: Global Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure Demand
marketLayer.fact: US semiconductor hardware providers and server OEMs reported sustained multi-quarter order backlogs driven by enterprise hyperscaler data center buildouts.
marketLayer.inference: High capital expenditures across global cloud service providers maintain strong earnings visibility for upstream chip design and equipment suppliers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Advanced semiconductor packaging capacity bottlenecks and potential cyclical weakness in legacy consumer electronics.
